name: Aster
description: Open-source terminal coding agent that reads your code, answers questions, edits files, runs commands, and reviews your changes

name: SDP (Social Daily Poster)
description: Self-hosted agent that harvests your Claude Code or Codex sessions, screenshots and messages each night, drafts one social post from the day's work, and routes it through a private Telegram bot for approval before it publishes to LinkedIn, X or Reddit

name: ENZO
description: Self-hosted BYOK AI workspace with multi-provider chat (Groq, OpenRouter, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Google AI), agents with scheduled runs, and skills like Gmail, Google Calendar, web search, and project generation

name: Bernstein
description: Open-source governance layer for AI agents

name: XYZZY
description: Self-hosted multiplayer workspace where a team branches a question into parallel specialist agent runs, includes or excludes each output, and publishes a Decision Brief with every claim linked to its source output; hash-chained event log, one Python process on SQLite, works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint

name: OrcaReplay
description: Records a coding agent below the harness — model traffic, shell exit codes, per-turn file changes and MCP calls on one timeline — then replays the run offline with the network off, or forks it from any checkpoint onto a different model

name: ValetFS
description: Secrets stay on a paired device and are lent to the agent's machine into daemon memory only, served over FUSE or loopback WebDAV; the daemon zero-wipes them when the pairing drops or a grace window expires

name: sofagent
description: Audit-first governance harness for AI coding agents: 24 rules enforced at commit time via git hooks, HMAC-chained audit log, snapshot rollback

name: AIWG
description: Deploys reusable agents, skills, rules, and governed workflows into the native project paths of multiple AI coding platforms

name: AgentLeak
description: Python toolkit for evaluating privacy leakage across agent traces, including tool calls, inter-agent messages, shared memory, and logs, with redacted reports and CI gates

name: ossbeat
description: Weekly write-ups tracking release notes and trends across open-source AI coding agent tooling (MCP, coding agent harnesses, agent-to-agent protocols)

name: Unkey
description: Open-source API key management and rate-limiting platform

name: MiaIA
description: An open-source C++20 neural-network engine and Unreal Engine 5 Studio for building, training, visualizing, inspecting, and debugging observable feed-forward networks
